_provenance.note: Stand-in for a recorded inference run. Regenerate with `uv run python -m udc.demo record` (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

mappings.reasoning: Material number is the unique article identifier and its values are numeric.
Material description is the human-readable product name, in French.
MTART could stand for material, but values like FERT and VERP look like codes.
Material group codes (BAGS, ACCS, SHOE) resemble categories but are internal codes.
Net price is the selling price amount.
Currency key holds ISO currency codes such as EUR.
Unrestricted stock is the quantity available to sell.
ERSDA is the SAP creation date, formatted YYYYMMDD.
